exposure: single food allergies (cow's milk as common trigger)
following social media accounts related to allergic proctocolitis
outcome: feeding behaviors (measured by Behavioral Pediatrics Feeding Assessment Scale - BPFAS total, child-related frequency/restriction/problem, parent-related frequency/problem, poor strategies scores)
parenting stress levels (measured by Parenting Stress Index-Short Form - parental distress, parent-child dysfunctional interaction, difficult child, total stress scores)
challenges during the transition to complementary foods
cohort: The study included parents of toddlers with FPIAP (n=89) and healthy controls (n=93).
finding: Toddlers with FPIAP initiated complementary feeding later, preferred vegetables, experienced more challenges transitioning to complementary foods, and their parents reported higher scores for parent-related frequency, total problem, child-related problem, parent-related problem, and poor strategies on BPFAS, as well as higher levels of parental distress, parent-child dysfunctional interaction, difficult child, and total stress, compared to healthy controls.
